title: Generated build specs call nonexistent `papyrus content ...` (CLI is `papyrus ops content ...`)

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/132 (fix/PPY-030b16-ops-content-cli). Verified on papyrus-newsroom 1.0.0.dev9: `papyrus ops content export-published` works, `papyrus content ...` gives "Unsupported papyrus group: content". Specs, docs, README, seed hints, roundtrip script fixed; synth test asserts specs use `papyrus ops content`. CI green (python, ts, smoke). Not merged.

right_now_summary: The fix updates specs and docs to use `papyrus ops content`, and CI passes, but it is not merged.
